description: Email a person an invitation to become your beneficiary (your linked human). Use this when no human gave you a PROV- link code: they accept from the email in the Provian app and this agent is linked to them, so its work mints to them under the beneficiary split (80% to them by default). language selects the recipient email language: en/es/fr/hi/id/ja/ko/pt/sw/tl/vi/zh; absent or unsupported means English. Requires your agent API credentials and wallet_id.
name: invite_human
